[[Emblem of the Avenger]] is a [[trophy]] used in the [[crafting]] of [[Conflux]], as well as used to purchase a variety of items.

== Notes == 
* The original purpose of this item was to upgrade the [[Slumbering Conflux]] ring (no legendary visuals) into Conflux (with legendary visuals). The introduction of the toggle checkbox to switch off the effects on Conflux with the [[Game updates/2021-07-13|July 13, 2021]] ([[Legendary Armory]]) release removed the acquisition method for Slumbering Conflux, and used the [[Conflux#Recipes|Historical Conflux recipe]].
* As originally written in the Spring 2023 Studio newsletter, a new use for this item was introduced later in 2023 with the [[Game updates/2023-06-06|June 6, 2023]] game update, specifically the addition of stat-swap recipes for the WvW infusion, and as a vendor currency.
